# The invoice totals 30.10, which the receivable holds exactly, so it posts.
# What cannot be done is dividing the 50.05 deposit against it: 30.10 would
# settle the invoice and 19.95 would be left, and 19.95 is not a figure this
# account holds — the deposit's own amount is not a whole number of its units.
#
# The two halves have to sum to the 50.05 that was there. Rounded to fit,
# 30.10 and 20.00 sum to 50.10, GnuCash answers the missing 0.05 with an
# Imbalance split, and the credit parked is not the figure this file asserts.
invoice "INV-COARSE-IMBALANCE"
	customer_id: "C-COARSE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-02-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-02-01
		description: "B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30.10
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-02-01
		due: 2026-02-28
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-COARSE-IMBALANCE"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-05
		amount: 50.05
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		prepayment: 19.95
		# 50.05 − 30.10, and not a figure this account can hold.
		memo: "Deposit"
